title: Miner Trails
description: With a keybind and woam! you have trails that leave behind you, perfect for those that yern the mines!
body:
A simple Fabric client-side mod that adds a visible trail behind your player while you move.

This mod places small particles behind you as you walk, allowing you to see where you’ve been for a short amount of time.

The trail is temporary and will slowly disappear after a few seconds, making it useful for tracking movement without cluttering the world.

Features

* Simple movement trail system
* Trail points disappear after 10 seconds
* Toggle trail on and off with a keybind (default: P)
* Client-side only (no server required)
* Lightweight and performance friendly

How it works

While you move, the mod places small visual markers behind your player every second. These markers fade away after a short time, letting you briefly retrace your steps.

Controls

P – Toggle trail on/off

Requirements

* Fabric Loader
* Fabric API
* Minecraft 1.21.11

Notes

Works in singleplayer and multiplayer
No server installation required
Purely visual client-side effect
